title: Inside the palace
introduction: Hanuma moves about the city of Lanka, going from one house to another in search of mother Seetha. He finds amazing wealth and riches abounding in that city of Ravana. He finally enters the huge house of Ravana.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये सुन्दर काण्डे षष्ठः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 6th chapter in Sundara Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
स निकामम् विमानेषु विषण्णः काम रूपधृत् |
विचचार पुनर्लङ्काम् लाघवेन समन्वितः
verses.iast:
sa nikāmam vimāneṣu viśhaṇṇaḥ kāma rūpadhṛt |
vicacāra punarlaṇ^kām lāghavena samanvitaḥ
verses.translation: That Hanuma who could assume any desire form, searching among houses had a lot of grief. Endowed with great speed, He roamed again the city of Lanka.

glosses.meaning: who could assume any desire form

verses.devanagari:
आससाद अथ लक्ष्मीवान् राक्षस इन्द्र निवेशनम् |
प्राकारेण अर्क वर्णेन भास्वरेण अभिसम्व्ऱ्तम्
verses.iast:
āsasāda atha lakṣmīvān rākṣasa indra niveśanam |
prākāreṇa arka varṇena bhāsvareṇa abhisamvRtam
verses.translation: After that, the glorious Hanuma neared the house of Ravana shining with the golden hue of Sun, surrounded by a compound wall.

verses.devanagari:
रक्षितम् राक्षसैर् भीमैः सिम्हैर् इव महद् वनम् |
समीक्षमाणो भवनम् चकाशे कपि कुन्जरः
verses.iast:
rakṣitam rākṣasair bhīmaiḥ simhair iva mahad vanam |
samīkṣamāṇo bhavanam cakāśe kapi kunjaraḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma shined purveying the building protected by horrible rakshasas, like a forest by lions.

verses.devanagari:
रूप्य कोप हितैः चित्रैः तोरणैर् हेम भूषितैः |
विचित्राभिः च कक्ष्याभिर् द्वारैः च रुचिरैर् व्ऱ्तम्
verses.iast:
rūpya kopa hitaiḥ citraiḥ toraṇair hema bhūṣitaiḥ |
vicitrābhiḥ ca kakṣyābhir dvāraiḥ ca rucirair vRtam
verses.translation: Ravana's house consisted of surprising archways decorated with sliver and gold, strange entrances and beautiful doors.

verses.devanagari:
गज आस्थितैर् महा मात्रैः शूरैः च विगत श्रमैः |
उपस्थितम् असम्हार्यैर् हयैः स्यन्दन यायिभिः
verses.iast:
gaja āsthitair mahā mātraiḥ śūraiḥ ca vigata śramaiḥ |
upasthitam asamhāryair hayaiḥ syandana yāyibhiḥ
verses.translation: Ravana's house waited upon by men on elephants, warriors, people with removed tiredness, drivers of elephants, by undefeatable horses, and by charioteers.

verses.devanagari:
सिम्ह व्याघ्र तनु त्राणैर् दान्त कान्चन राजतैः |
घोषवद्भिर् विचित्रैः च सदा विचरितम् रथैः
verses.iast:
simha vyāghra tanu trāṇair dānta kāncana rājataiḥ |
ghoṣavadbhir vicitraiḥ ca sadā vicaritam rathaiḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Ravana's house with protective shields made of lion and tiger skins, decorated with ivory, gold and silver, being roamed always by strange chariots with great sound.

glosses.meaning: with protective shields made of lion and tiger skins

verses.devanagari:
बहु रत्न समाकीर्णम् पर अर्ध्य आसन भाजनम् |
महा रथ समावासम् महा रथ महा आसनम्
verses.iast:
bahu ratna samākīrṇam para ardhya āsana bhājanam |
mahā ratha samāvāsam mahā ratha mahā āsanam
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Ravana's house filled with a lot of diamonds, having valuable seats and utensils, abode of great warriors, with great chariots and great utensils.

glosses.meaning: filled with a lot of diamonds
with great chariots and great utensils.

verses.devanagari:
दृश्यैः च परम उदारैः तैः तैः च मृग पक्षिभिः |
विविधैर् बहु साहस्रैः परिपूर्णम् समन्ततः
verses.iast:
dṛśyaiḥ ca parama udāraiḥ taiḥ taiḥ ca mṛga pakṣibhiḥ |
vividhair bahu sāhasraiḥ paripūrṇam samantataḥ
verses.translation: Filled all around with those and those various kinds of animals and birds in thousands, lovely to watch - very beautiful ones.

verses.devanagari:
विनीतैर् अन्त पालैः च रक्षोभिः च सुरक्षितम् |
मुख्याभिः च वर स्त्रीभिः परिपूर्णम् समन्ततः
verses.iast:
vinītair anta pālaiḥ ca rakṣobhiḥ ca surakṣitam |
mukhyābhiḥ ca vara strībhiḥ paripūrṇam samantataḥ
verses.translation: Well protected by well trained rakshasas, protecting the inner area, filled all over by best women who were important.

verses.devanagari:
मुदित प्रमदा रत्नम् राक्षस इन्द्र निवेशनम् |
वर आभरण निर्ह्रादैः समुद्र स्वन निह्स्वनम्
verses.iast:
mudita pramadā ratnam rākṣasa indra niveśanam |
vara ābharaṇa nirhrādaiḥ samudra svana nihsvanam
verses.translation: Having happy women, the abode of Ravana with the tinkling of best jewellery had a sound like that of an ocean.

glosses.meaning: with the tinkling of best jewellery
had a sound like that of an ocean.

verses.devanagari:
तद् राज गुण सम्पन्नम् मुख्यैः च वर चन्दनैः |
भेरी म्ऱ्दन्ग अभिरुतम् शन्ख घोष विनादितम्
verses.iast:
tad rāja guṇa sampannam mukhyaiḥ ca vara candanaiḥ |
bherī mRdanga abhirutam śankha ghoṣa vināditam
verses.translation: Together with royal insignia, with best scents and sandal wood, spread with great number of people like a great forest with lions.

glosses.meaning: with best scents and sandal woods

verses.devanagari:
भेरीमृदङ्गाभिरुतम् शङ्खघोषनिनादितम् |
नित्य अर्चितम् पर्व हुतम् पूजितम् राक्षसैः सदा
verses.iast:
bherīmṛdaṇ^gābhirutam śaṇ^khaghośhanināditam |
nitya arcitam parva hutam pūjitam rākṣasaiḥ sadā
verses.translation: Resounded by bheris and mridagas, resounded by the sound of conch-shells, prayed upon daily by Rakshsas, with rituals on festivals, always worshipped by rakshasas.

glosses.meaning: resounded by the sound of conch-shells

verses.devanagari:
समुद्रम् इव गम्भीरम् समुद्रम् इव निह्स्वनम् |
महात्मानो महद् वेश्म महा रत्न परिच्चदम्
महा जन समाकीर्णम् ददर्श स महा कपिः |
verses.iast:
samudram iva gambhīram samudram iva nihsvanam |
mahātmāno mahad veśma mahā ratna pariccadam
mahā jana samākīrṇam dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ |
verses.translation: The great Hanuma saw the wealthy Ravana's huge house, inscrutable like an ocean, like a noiseless ocean, with a roof embedded with great diamondsand filled with great diamonds.

glosses.meaning: with a roof embedded with great diamonds

verses.devanagari:
विराजमानम् वपुषा गज अश्व रथ सम्कुलम्
लन्का आभरणम् इति एव सो अमन्यत महा कपिः |
चचार हनुमांस्तत्र रावणस्य समीपतः
verses.iast:
virājamānam vapuṣā gaja aśva ratha samkulam
lankā ābharaṇam iti eva so amanyata mahā kapiḥ |
cacāra hanumāṃstatra rāvaṇasya samīpataḥ
verses.translation: That great Hanuma thought the house, which was shining with its form filled with elephants, horses, chariots, to be the jewel of Lanka. Hanuma walked about there in the near-hood of Ravana.

glosses.meaning: to be the jewel of Lanka

verses.devanagari:
गृहाद् गृहम् राक्षसानाम् उद्यानानि च वानरः |
वीक्षमाणो हि असम्त्रस्तः प्रासादामः च चचार सः
verses.iast:
gṛhād gṛham rākṣasānām udyānāni ca vānaraḥ |
vīkṣamāṇo hi asamtrastaḥ prāsādāmḥ ca cacāra saḥ
verses.translation: That Hanuma moved about from one house to another of Rakshasas and also parks and observing in all directions without fear and also courtyards.

verses.devanagari:
अवप्लुत्य महा वेगः प्रहस्तस्य निवेशनम् |
ततो अन्यत् पुप्लुवे वेश्म महा पार्श्वस्य वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
avaplutya mahā vegaḥ prahastasya niveśanam |
tato anyat pupluve veśma mahā pārśvasya vīryavān
verses.translation: Hanuma with great prowess, and one with great speed, jumped for the house of Prahasta and from there leapt for another house that of Mahaparshva.

verses.devanagari:
अथ मेघ प्रतीकाशम् कुम्भ कर्ण निवेशनम् |
विभीषणस्य च तथा पुप्लुवे स महा कपिः
verses.iast:
atha megha pratīkāśam kumbha karṇa niveśanam |
vibhīṣaṇasya ca tathā pupluve sa mahā kapiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter the great Hanuma leapt for the house of Kumbhakarna which resembled a cloud and in the same way for the house of Vibhishana.

verses.devanagari:
महा उदरस्य च तथा विरूप अक्षस्य चैव हि |
विद्युज् जिह्वस्य भवनम् विद्युन् मालेः तथैव च
वज्र दम्ष्ट्रस्य च तथा पुप्लुवे स महा कपिः |
verses.iast:
mahā udarasya ca tathā virūpa akṣasya caiva hi |
vidyuj jihvasya bhavanam vidyun māleḥ tathaiva ca
vajra damṣṭrasya ca tathā pupluve sa mahā kapiḥ |
verses.translation: That great Hanuma in the same way leapt for the house of Mahodara and also that of Virupaaksha, that of Viddutjihva.

verses.devanagari:
शुकस्य च महा वेगः सारणस्य च धीमतः |
तथा च इन्द्रजितो वेश्म जगाम हरि यूथपः
verses.iast:
śukasya ca mahā vegaḥ sāraṇasya ca dhīmataḥ |
tathā ca indrajito veśma jagāma hari yūthapaḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma the commander of Vanara army with great radiance went for the intellectual Suka's house, for Sarana's house, and in the same way for the house of Indrajit.

glosses.meaning: Hanuma the commander of Vanara army

verses.devanagari:
जम्बु मालेः सुमालेः च जगाम हरि यूथपः
रश्मि केतोः च भवनम् सूर्य शत्रोः तथैव च |
वज्रकायस्य च तथा पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः
verses.iast:
jambu māleḥ sumāleḥ ca jagāma hari yūthapaḥ
raśmi ketoḥ ca bhavanam sūrya śatroḥ tathaiva ca |
vajrakāyasya ca tathā pupluve sa mahākapiḥ
verses.translation: The best among Vanaras Hanuma went for the house of Jambumali and for the house of Sumali. The great Hanuma jumped for the house Rasmiketu and in the same way for the house of Suryaketu and in that way for the building of Vajrakaaya.

glosses.meaning: and for the house of Sumali

verses.devanagari:
धूम्र अक्षस्य च सम्पातेर् भवनम् मारुत आत्मजः |
विद्युद् रूपस्य भीमस्य घनस्य विघनस्य च
शुक नाभस्य वक्रस्य शठस्य विकटस्य च |
ह्रस्व कर्णस्य दम्ष्ट्रस्य रोमशस्य च रक्षसः
युद्ध उन्मत्तस्य मत्तस्य ध्वज ग्रीवस्य नादिनः |
विद्युज् जिह्व इन्द्र जिह्वानाम् तथा हस्ति मुखस्य च
करालस्य पिशाचस्य शोणित अक्षस्य चैव हि |
verses.iast:
dhūmra akṣasya ca sampāter bhavanam māruta ātmajaḥ |
vidyud rūpasya bhīmasya ghanasya vighanasya ca
śuka nābhasya vakrasya śaṭhasya vikaṭasya ca |
hrasva karṇasya damṣṭrasya romaśasya ca rakṣasaḥ
yuddha unmattasya mattasya dhvaja grīvasya nādinaḥ |
vidyuj jihva indra jihvānām tathā hasti mukhasya ca
karālasya piśācasya śoṇita akṣasya caiva hi |
verses.translation: Hanuma jumped for Dhumrah's house, for Sampati's house, for Vidhudrupa's, Bhiima's house, for Ghana's house and Vighana's house, for Sukhana's house, for Vakra's, for Satha's house and also for Vikata's house, for Brahmakarna's house, for Damshra's house, for Roma's house, for Raksha's house, for Ydhonmata's and Indrajihva's house, in the same way for Hastimukas house, for Karala's house, for Pisacha's house, and also for the building of Shonita.

glosses.meaning: and also for the building of Shonita.

verses.devanagari:
क्रममाणः क्रमेण एव हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः
तेषु तेषु महा अर्हेषु भवनेषु महा यशाः |
तेषाम् ऱ्^द्धिमताम् ऋद्धिम् ददर्श स महा कपिः
verses.iast:
kramamāṇaḥ krameṇa eva hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ
teṣu teṣu mahā arheṣu bhavaneṣu mahā yaśāḥ |
teṣām R^ddhimatām ṛddhim dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ
verses.translation: The son of Vayu, one with great fame, great one among Vanaras , moving about in a sequence in those and those best buildings, saw the wealth of those rakshasas, who were rich.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वेषाम् समतिक्रम्य भवनानि समन्ततः |
आससाद अथ लक्ष्मीवान् राक्षस इन्द्र निवेशनम्
verses.iast:
sarveṣām samatikramya bhavanāni samantataḥ |
āsasāda atha lakṣmīvān rākṣasa indra niveśanam
verses.translation: The glorious Hanuma passing everyone's houses all round, there-after neared the house of Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्य उपशायिन्यो ददर्श हरि सत्तमः |
विचरन् हरि शार्दूलो राक्षसीर् विकृत ईक्षणाः
शूल मुद्गल हस्ताः च शक्तो तोमर धारिणीः |
verses.iast:
rāvaṇasya upaśāyinyo dadarśa hari sattamaḥ |
vicaran hari śārdūlo rākṣasīr vikṛta īkṣaṇāḥ
śūla mudgala hastāḥ ca śakto tomara dhāriṇīḥ |
verses.translation: Hanuma best among Vanaras, tiger among Vanaras, moving about saw Rakshas women, those who were sleeping near to Ravana, those who had horrific eyes, those who had Sulaas, Mudgaras in their hands, those who had Shaktis and Tomaras.

glosses.meaning: those who were sleeping near to Ravana
those who had Shaktis and Tomaras.

verses.devanagari:
ददर्श विविधान् गुल्मामः तस्य रक्षः पतेर् गृहे |
राक्षसांश्च महाकायान्नानाप्रहरणोद्यतान्
verses.iast:
dadarśa vividhān gulmāmḥ tasya rakṣaḥ pater gṛhe |
rākśasāṃśca mahākāyānnānāpraharaṇodyatān
verses.translation: Hanuma saw in that house of Ravana a variety of army divisions and also Rakshasas those who had huge bodies having different weapons raise up.

verses.devanagari:
रक्तान् श्वेतान् सितामः चैव हरीमः चैव महा जवान्
कुलीनान् रूप सम्पन्नान् गजान् पर गज आरुजान् |
निष्ठितान् गज शिखायाम् ऐरावत समान् युधि
निहन्त्ऱ्ऱ्न् पर सैन्यानाम् गृहे तस्मिन् ददर्श सः |
क्षरतः च यथा मेघान् स्रवतः च यथा गिरीन्
मेघ स्तनित निर्घोषान् दुर्धर्षान् समरे परैः |
verses.iast:
raktān śvetān sitāmḥ caiva harīmḥ caiva mahā javān
kulīnān rūpa sampannān gajān para gaja ārujān |
niṣṭhitān gaja śikhāyām airāvata samān yudhi
nihantRRn para sainyānām gṛhe tasmin dadarśa saḥ |
kṣarataḥ ca yathā meghān sravataḥ ca yathā girīn
megha stanita nirghoṣān durdharṣān samare paraiḥ |
verses.translation: That Hanuma in that house saw horses in red colour and in white colour, slightly whitish, capable of great speed, elephants born in a good breed having good appearance capable of harassing enemy's elephants, skilled in good elephant training, equalling Iraavata, capable of killing enemies armies in war, rutting like raining clouds, like mountains with water falls that are pouring down, with trumpeting resembling thundering of clouds, unassailable by enemies in a battle.

glosses.meaning: with trumpeting resembling thundering of clouds

verses.devanagari:
सहस्रम् वाहिनीः तत्र जाम्बूनद परिष्कृताः
हेम जालैर् अविच्चिन्नाः तरुण आदित्य सम्निभाः |
ददर्श राक्षस इन्द्रस्य रावणस्य निवेशने
verses.iast:
sahasram vāhinīḥ tatra jāmbūnada pariṣkṛtāḥ
hema jālair aviccinnāḥ taruṇa āditya samnibhāḥ |
dadarśa rākṣasa indrasya rāvaṇasya niveśane
verses.translation: There Hanuma saw in the house of Ravana, the king of rakshasas, army divisions in thousands decorated with gold, covered with heaps of gold, equalling the Sun who has fully come up.

glosses.meaning: equalling the sun who has fully come up.

verses.devanagari:
शिबिका विविध आकाराः स कपिर् मारुत आत्मजः |
लता गृहाणि चित्राणि चित्र शाला गृहाणि च
क्रीडा गृहाणि च अन्यानि दारु पर्वतकान् अपि |
कामस्य गृहकम् रम्यम् दिवा गृहकम् एव च
ददर्श राक्षस इन्द्रस्य रावणस्य निवेशने |
verses.iast:
śibikā vividha ākārāḥ sa kapir māruta ātmajaḥ |
latā gṛhāṇi citrāṇi citra śālā gṛhāṇi ca
krīḍā gṛhāṇi ca anyāni dāru parvatakān api |
kāmasya gṛhakam ramyam divā gṛhakam eva ca
dadarśa rākṣasa indrasya rāvaṇasya niveśane |
verses.translation: That Hanuma the son of Vayu saw in the house of Ravana the king of rakshasas, palanquins of various shapes, wonderful bowers, art galleries and other pleasure houses which were constructed with wooden mountains, house for sexual delight and a beautiful diurnal house.

verses.devanagari:
स मन्दर तल प्रख्यम् मयूर स्थान सम्कुलम्
ध्वज यष्टिभिर् आकीर्णम् ददर्श भवन उत्तमम् |
अनन्त रत्न निचयम् निधि जालम् समन्ततः
धीर निष्ठित कर्म अन्तम् गृहम् भूत पतेर् इव |
verses.iast:
sa mandara tala prakhyam mayūra sthāna samkulam
dhvaja yaṣṭibhir ākīrṇam dadarśa bhavana uttamam |
ananta ratna nicayam nidhi jālam samantataḥ
dhīra niṣṭhita karma antam gṛham bhūta pater iva |
verses.translation: That Hanuma saw the best among buildings equalling mount Mandara filled with pens for peacocks, spread by flag staffs managed by courageous ones like the house of Kubera filled with many diamonds and also heaps of riches.

verses.devanagari:
अर्चिर्भिः च अपि रत्नानाम् तेजसा रावणस्य च
विरराज अथ तद् वेश्म रश्मिमान् इव रश्मिभिः |
verses.iast:
arcirbhiḥ ca api ratnānām tejasā rāvaṇasya ca
virarāja atha tad veśma raśmimān iva raśmibhiḥ |
verses.translation: That building shone by the rays of diamonds, by the splendour of Ravana like the Sun by rays.

verses.devanagari:
जाम्बू नदमयानि एव शयनानि आसनानि च
भाजनानि च शुभ्राणि ददर्श हरि यूथपः |
verses.iast:
jāmbū nadamayāni eva śayanāni āsanāni ca
bhājanāni ca śubhrāṇi dadarśa hari yūthapaḥ |
verses.translation: Hanuma leader of Vanaras saw couches and seats and chief vessels all made with gold.

verses.devanagari:
मध्व् आसव कृत क्लेदम् मणि भाजन सम्कुलम्
मनो रमम् असम्बाधम् कुबेर भवनम् यथा |
नूपुराणाम् च घोषेण कान्चीनाम् निनदेन च
मृदन्ग तल घोषैः च घोषवद्भिर् विनादितम् |
प्रासाद सम्घात युतम् स्त्री रत्न शत सम्कुलम्
सुव्यूढ कक्ष्यम् हनुमान् प्रविवेश महा गृहम् |
verses.iast:
madhv āsava kṛta kledam maṇi bhājana samkulam
mano ramam asambādham kubera bhavanam yathā |
nūpurāṇām ca ghoṣeṇa kāncīnām ninadena ca
mṛdanga tala ghoṣaiḥ ca ghoṣavadbhir vināditam |
prāsāda samghāta yutam strī ratna śata samkulam
suvyūḍha kakṣyam hanumān praviveśa mahā gṛham |
verses.translation: Hanuma entered the big house moistened by liquor made of honey, filled with vessels made of gems delightful one, un-congested one like the building of Kubera resounded by the sound of tinkles by the sound of waist ornaments, by the sound of percussion on Mrudangas with deep sound, which consisted of many mansions filled with hundreds of best women, encircled by many spacious enclosures.

glosses.meaning: moistened by liquor made of honey
filled with vessels made of gems
by the sound of percussion on Mrudangas
filled with hundreds of best women
